title: Head of Financial Institutions ING Czech Republic
full_description:
Your work environment
We operate at the heart of ING’s wholesale banking franchise in the Czech Republic providing many opportunities for further career advancement.
This position involves contacts with many different ING departments & clients as well as ING’s strong international network.
Your roleAs a Head of Financial Institutions CZ your responsibilities include:
Managing the Financial Institutions Department
Growth of FI WB business
Widening of the client base through prospect acquisition
Keeping excellent personal relationships with established and prospective clients
Bearing the ultimate responsibility for the assigned core client relationships
Sales of full range WB products to eligible clients
Interfacing the client and the bank, keeping clients satisfied through product delivery to clients´ expectations
Identifying marketing strategy, budget responsibility, and personal performance evaluation of subordinates
Your responsibilities
You are a strong leader with experience in end-to-end responsibility
You drive strategy setting and execution
You are a true salesperson with strong commercial drive
You embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment
You are an excellent stakeholder manager
A ‘can do’ mentality, proactive, resourceful, and willing to go the extra mile
We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you will stay curious. Keep learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we will back you to develop into an even more awesome version of yourself.
Academic master's degree, 5+ years of WB experience with demonstrated understanding of FI sector, clients as well as products
Demonstrated leadership experience with end-to-end responsibility
Cultural- and organizational sensitivity, excellent interpersonal skills
An entrepreneurial mind set, efficient team player
Excellent written and verbal communications skills in Czech and English
We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life.
The benefits of working with us at ING include:
30 vacation days depending on contract
A wide array of benefits (e.g. Annual bonus, Cafeteria points, Multisport card, extra 10 days of annual leave, Pension/life insurance contribution, home office support)
Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
An informal working environment with innovative colleagues
Safe and pleasant working environment
A modern culture with flexible options for remote work and office presence (located at Českomoravská, Prague 9)
At ING we aim to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone can develop and have an impact on our customers and society.
QuestionsContact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.
ING’s vision is to unlock our people’s full potential through our inclusive culture where everyone has the opportunity to develop and have impact for our customers and society. To achieve this vision, our policies support diversity, equity, and inclusion.
